fields.title: 📖 Allah’s Voice: not like the voices of creation
fields.body:
🖋️ **al-Bukhārī, Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal and Ibn Taymiyyah** said:

> ***“The Voice of Allah does not resemble the voices of creation.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Allah speaks with a Voice, as it has been transmitted, without equating and without the question of how; denying this text belongs to the path of the Jahmiyyah.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Bukhārī, Khalq Afʿāl al-ʿIbād; Ibn Abī Yaʿlā, Ṭabaqāt al-Ḥanābilah, Biographie ʿAbdullāh ibn Aḥmad; Ibn Taymiyyah, Majmūʿ al-Fatāwā, Kitāb al-Asmāʾ waṣ-Ṣifāt.
immutable.book: Khalq Afʿāl al-ʿIbād / Ṭabaqāt al-Ḥanābilah / Majmūʿ al-Fatāwā
